# Public age keys the nightly database backup is encrypted to, one per line.
#
# Only the PUBLIC key (age1…) belongs here. The matching secret key is held by
# the operator offline and never enters this repository, GitHub or a Claude
# configuration. Generating one: docs/runbook-restore.md, "The key pair".
#
# Until a key is listed, `pnpm db:backup` refuses to run — a backup is never
# stored unencrypted.
